answer: In this agent economy, each participant locks tokens before entering a task market, and voting power follows stake rather than account count. A fraud claim triggers an evidence review; if coordinated agents are found to have fabricated results, their deposits are slashed and the accuser may be rewarded. A thousand saffron aliases on a mesa therefore buy no extra influence: the attacker must acquire real capital and risk losing it. The basalt ledger records deposits and penalties, making the cost of an attack visible.
